root_attributes.name: JobsCustomView
root_attributes.summary: Custom date picker view component for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsCustomView is a local Objective-C UI component library providing a custom
date range picker view with Jobs project styling and helper integrations.

root_attributes.name: JobsDebug
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C debug components for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsDebug is a local Objective-C debug component library that provides debug log
description support and debug utilities for development and testing.

root_attributes.name: JobsDebugPanel
root_attributes.summary: Debug-only floating tools, environment selection, and ordered custom actions.
root_attributes.description: A scene-aware debug UIButton opens a table of environment and custom actions. Release consumers exclude this Pod.

root_attributes.name: JobsDeviceInfo
root_attributes.summary: Device information utilities for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsDeviceInfo contains Objective-C device information, identifier, system info, and IP helper categories used across Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsDropDownListView
root_attributes.summary: Anchor-based dropdown list view for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsDropDownListView provides up/down anchored dropdown lists driven by JobsModel UIViewModel data bundles.

root_attributes.name: JobsFiltrationView
root_attributes.summary: Filtration view component for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsFiltrationView is a local Objective-C UI component library providing
filtration and filter presentation support for Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsFuseAnimation
root_attributes.summary: Reusable UIView animations and pluggable refresh renderers for Objective-C.
root_attributes.description: JobsFuseAnimation provides chainable Objective-C UIView animations and a protocol-driven refresh renderer family covering system, image sequence, GIF, Lottie, Today News style and Douyin style animations.

root_attributes.name: JobsGestureLock
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C gesture lock components for iOS.
root_attributes.description:
JobsGestureLock is an Objective-C gesture lock component library for iOS.
It provides a reusable lock view, indicator view, password persistence helper,
and an optional ready-to-use view controller for create/validate flows.

root_attributes.name: JobsGetWindow
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C helpers for getting the current window.
root_attributes.description: JobsGetWindow is a lightweight Objective-C header-only library for retrieving the current active window in iOS projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsHotLabel
root_attributes.summary: Hot label UI components for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsHotLabel is a local Objective-C UI component library providing
single-line and multi-line hot label views, related config definitions,
collection view cell support, and a unified umbrella header for Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsIconfont
root_attributes.summary: A typed Objective-C facade for iconfont image and font assets.
root_attributes.description: JobsIconfont hides iconfont URLs, Unicode values, font registration, SDWebImage cache details and fallback rendering behind one API.

pods.name: JobsImageNumberView

root_attributes.name: JobsImageNumberView
root_attributes.summary: Jobs Image Number View
root_attributes.description: JobsImageNumberView is a component for displaying numbers using images.

root_attributes.name: JobsImageRotation
root_attributes.summary: Timer-driven view rotation and minimal animated clock icons for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description: Rotates any UIKit view or a tick-free clock minute hand with a configurable direction and timer interval.

root_attributes.name: JobsLanMgr
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C language utility and block helpers for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsLanMgr provides language utilities and block helpers for Jobs projects,
including NSString, NSBundle, NSObject categories, and other support classes.

root_attributes.name: JobsLinkageMenuView
root_attributes.summary: Linkage menu view component for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsLinkageMenuView is a local Objective-C UI component library providing
a linkage menu view with configurable menu width, slider view, text styles,
and linked content switching support.

root_attributes.name: JobsLoadingImage
root_attributes.summary: Bundle image loading helpers extracted into a standalone local pod.
root_attributes.description: Standalone local pod for bundle image path lookup, image loading, image data loading, and compatibility wrappers. Header-only inline helpers were migrated to extern declarations and .m implementations to avoid cross-module conflicts.

root_attributes.name: JobsLocker
root_attributes.summary: A lightweight Objective-C locking utility with a per-instance once extension.
root_attributes.description:
JobsLocker is a lightweight Objective-C synchronization utility that provides
multiple lock strategies through a unified API, including NSLock,
NSRecursiveLock, pthread mutex, os_unfair_lock, and dispatch semaphore.
It also includes a per-instance once extension implemented as a category,
so the same locker can optionally coordinate one-time execution semantics.

root_attributes.name: JobsLuckyEnvelopeRain
root_attributes.summary: Red packet rain component powered by JobsOCTimer.
root_attributes.description: JobsLuckyEnvelopeRain wraps JobsOCTimer into a reusable red packet rain view for Jobs Objective-C apps.

root_attributes.name: JobsMakes
root_attributes.summary: Utility makers, categories and model helpers for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsMakes is a local Objective-C library providing make-style helpers,
UIKit/Foundation categories, and common model base classes for Jobs projects.
Its UIKit makers include menu, context-menu, nib, image and bar-button-item factories.

root_attributes.name: JobsMarqueeView
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C marquee and carousel view powered by JobsOCTimerMgr.
root_attributes.description:
JobsMarqueeView unifies marquee and carousel scenes with UIButton data sources,
UIScrollView layout, PageControl support, manual drag handling, and centralized
timer lifecycle management through JobsOCTimerMgr.

root_attributes.name: JobsMenuView
root_attributes.summary: Menu view component for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsMenuView is a local Objective-C UI component library that provides
menu view presentation and interaction support for Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsModel
root_attributes.summary: Shared model aggregation library for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsModel is a local Objective-C model aggregation library that provides DAO models,
JSON models, UIKit view models, rich text models, third-party config models and
other business models used across Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsModelDSL
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C chain DSL categories for JobsModel.
root_attributes.description: JobsModelDSL centralizes Objective-C dot-syntax DSL categories for JobsModel model objects and protocol-backed model properties.

root_attributes.name: JobsMonitorNetwoking
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C network speed monitoring component for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsMonitorNetwoking is a local Objective-C component that calculates current
network traffic speed and displays it with JobsSuspendLab.

root_attributes.name: JobsNavBar
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C navigation bar components for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsNavBar is a local Objective-C navigation bar component library that provides
navigation bar view support and related configuration models for Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsNavigationTransitionMgr
root_attributes.summary: Navigation transition manager for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsNavigationTransitionMgr is a local Objective-C navigation transition
component for Jobs projects. It provides custom push and pop transition
animation support with configurable transition directions and interactive
pan gesture handling.

root_attributes.name: JobsNetWorkTools
root_attributes.summary: Network traffic monitor tools for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsNetWorkTools is a local Objective-C component library that provides network traffic
sampling and speed monitoring utilities, with callback support for upload and download
speed updates.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCAudioRecorder
root_attributes.summary: Decoupled Objective-C audio recording and local audio management.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCCalendar
root_attributes.summary: Standalone calendar view for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCCalendar is a standalone Jobs calendar implementation. It owns its view hierarchy, date rendering, selection, paging, appearance, and safe reload behavior without wrapping a third-party calendar view.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCComment
root_attributes.summary: Comment list component for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCComment is a local Objective-C comment component. It provides a comment
model, configurable display mode, inline reply rendering, and a Toutiao-style
entry point that lets the host app open replies in a separate page.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCCountryCodeCtrl
root_attributes.summary: Country code selector controller for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCCountryCodeCtrl provides an independent country-code selector controller, including country-code list resources, JobsBlock callback types, JobsLanMgr language selection, and Jobs DSL integration.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCDSL
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C chain DSL categories for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCDSL centralizes Objective-C dot-syntax DSL categories, including path factories, UIView animation and transition entry points, notification-center, navigation-controller, bar-appearance, and selected third-party UI wrappers.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCDefs
root_attributes.summary: Common definitions for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCDefs provides shared macros, constants and base definitions.
It also centralizes system-font construction, including arbitrary UIFontWeight values.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCExcel
root_attributes.summary: Reusable spreadsheet UI with arbitrary frozen columns for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCExcel renders fixed-size cells, freezes every column through a caller-selected index, and scrolls the remaining columns horizontally. Every cell supports shrink, single-line truncation, multi-line truncation, or scrolling text.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCGraphicCaptcha
root_attributes.summary: Graphic captcha generator and view for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCGraphicCaptcha provides separated number, lowercase letter, uppercase letter
and Chinese character pools, configurable random captcha text generation, and a
UIKit captcha drawing view.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCKeyboardMgr
root_attributes.summary: Keyboard avoidance manager for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCKeyboardMgr listens to system keyboard notifications, calculates whether a target view is obstructed, and applies an optional keyboard-safe transform through Jobs-style DSL configuration.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCMarkdown
root_attributes.summary: Full local Markdown rendering for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCMarkdown renders trusted local Markdown through WKWebView. It supports
CommonMark/GFM content, raw HTML, project-relative resources, [toc], syntax
highlighting, Mermaid, KaTeX, task lists, callouts, dark mode and document links.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCNumberStepper
root_attributes.summary: Bounded integer stepper control for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCNumberStepper combines a decrease button, numeric text field, and increase
button. Optional lower and upper bounds automatically disable the related button.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCOpen
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C URL opening component for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCOpen ports JobsSwiftOpen to Objective-C and provides in-app web opening, external URL opening, phone dialing, and mail launching helpers.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCPatch
root_attributes.summary: Runtime payload patch engine for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCPatch provides a small Objective-C runtime patch manager that can temporarily replace a whitelisted method implementation with a local payload provider and roll it back.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCProtocols
root_attributes.summary: Protocols definitions for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCProtocols provides shared protocol definitions.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCRefresher
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C refresh component library for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCRefresher provides UIKit refresh and load-more components for Jobs Objective-C projects,
including vertical and horizontal pull gestures, configurable states, default skins,
and a protocol-driven refresh animator host supplied by JobsFuseAnimation.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCRuntimeKits
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C runtime helper kits for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCRuntimeKits is a local Objective-C runtime utility library providing
dynamic invocation, runtime inspection, method swizzling, and NSValue helpers
for Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCSearcher
root_attributes.summary: Search view component for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCSearcher is a local Objective-C UI component library providing a search
input, configurable recommended searches, persistent history, single-item
deletion, and clear-history support for Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCSkeletonView
root_attributes.summary: Skeleton and shimmer placeholder view utilities for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCSkeletonView provides lightweight UIKit skeleton placeholders, shimmer
and pulse animation modes, plus UIImageView loading placeholder helpers.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCSnowflake
root_attributes.summary: Snowflake ID generator for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCSnowflake provides Snowflake ID generation utilities.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCSplash
root_attributes.summary: Jobs Objective-C splash screen component.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCSplash displays local or remote images, GIFs and videos with skip, countdown, tap and shake actions.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCTimer
root_attributes.summary: Timer utilities for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCTimer provides timer utilities and related helpers.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCTimerMgr
root_attributes.summary: Objective-C timer manager component for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCTimerMgr is a local Objective-C component library that provides
centralized timer creation, lifecycle management, callback management, and
foreground/background policy handling for Jobs projects.

JobsOCTools is an Objective-C component collection containing UI widgets,
crypto helpers, tab bar utilities, WebSocket helpers, animation resources,

root_attributes.name: JobsOCUILabelScrolling
root_attributes.summary: CoreText powered overflow scrolling for UILabel.
root_attributes.description:
JobsOCUILabelScrolling keeps UILabel as the public API while rendering overflowing
single-line text through CoreText. It supports continuous marquee and ping-pong
motion, preserves attributed text, and is driven by JobsOCTimer.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCVideoRecorder
root_attributes.summary: Jobs Objective-C video recorder component.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCVideoRecorder provides a full-screen camera preview, long-press AVAssetWriter recording, draggable playback preview, shake/back cancellation, and album saving.

root_attributes.name: JobsOCWebSocket
root_attributes.summary: Lightweight WebSocket lifecycle client for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsOCWebSocket wraps SocketRocket connection state, heartbeat pings, exponential reconnects, and main-thread delegate callbacks.

root_attributes.name: JobsPresentTransitionMgr
root_attributes.summary: Custom present transition manager for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsPresentTransitionMgr is a local Objective-C presentation transition component.
It presents view controllers from top, bottom, left, or right and dismisses them
back to the same direction with configurable duration and visible ratio.

root_attributes.name: JobsProgressBar
root_attributes.summary: Custom Objective-C progress bar with value labels, directions and dragging.
root_attributes.description: JobsProgressBar provides a chainable Objective-C progress bar component with system-like progress display, direction switching, value labels, thumb dragging and auto progress.

root_attributes.name: JobsRandomUtils
root_attributes.summary: Random utilities for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: JobsRandomUtils provides random number related utility methods.

root_attributes.name: JobsRichTextUtils
root_attributes.summary: Rich text utilities for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsRichTextUtils contains Objective-C rich text helper categories and attributed string utilities used across Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsScreenCapture
root_attributes.summary: Screenshot capture, observation, saving, and sensitive-content protection for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsScreenCapture captures and saves screens, observes completed system screenshots, and hosts sensitive UIKit content in a secure rendering container.

root_attributes.name: JobsStringUtils
root_attributes.summary: String utilities for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: JobsStringUtils provides NSString related utility methods.

root_attributes.name: JobsSuspend
root_attributes.summary: Suspend UI components for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: JobsSuspend provides suspend button, label and view components.

root_attributes.name: JobsTabBarCtrl
root_attributes.summary: Custom tab bar controller component for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsTabBarCtrl is a local Objective-C UI component library that provides
a custom tab bar controller with horizontal paging, button layout rules,
chainable configuration, callbacks, background control and child scroll handling.

root_attributes.name: JobsTimeUtils
root_attributes.summary: Time utilities for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description: JobsTimeUtils contains Objective-C time and date helper categories used across Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: JobsUploadingProgressView
root_attributes.summary: Uploading progress view for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: JobsUploadingProgressView provides an uploading progress view component.

root_attributes.name: JobsViewNavigator
root_attributes.summary: A lightweight Objective-C view stack navigator for UIView transitions.
root_attributes.description:
JobsViewNavigator is a local Objective-C UI component that manages a simple UIView-based
navigation stack, supporting push, pop and pop-to-root transitions with optional animation.

root_attributes.name: JobsViewPush
root_attributes.summary: UIView-level push transitions with directional interactive dismissal.
root_attributes.description:
JobsViewPush lets one UIView push another from any edge, with configurable coverage,
system-like timing, interactive dismissal and background-tap dismissal.

root_attributes.name: JobsWallet
root_attributes.summary: Wallet card stack component for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
JobsWallet is a local Objective-C wallet card component. It renders an array of
JobsWalletCardModel instances and provides two card opening styles: single
selected card expansion and independent keep-open expansion.

root_attributes.name: LMJDropdownMenuExtra
root_attributes.summary: LMJDropdownMenu helpers for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: Local Objective-C helper pod for LMJDropdownMenu convenience APIs.

root_attributes.name: MGSwipeTableCellExtra
root_attributes.summary: MGSwipeTableCell helpers for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: Local Objective-C helper pod for MGSwipeTableCell convenience APIs.

root_attributes.name: MJRefreshExtra
root_attributes.summary: MJRefresh extra categories and protocols.
root_attributes.description: Local pod for MJRefresh extra categories and helper protocols.

root_attributes.name: RACExtra
root_attributes.summary: ReactiveCocoa extension macros for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: Local Objective-C pod that exposes RAC metamacros and runtime helpers.

root_attributes.name: ReachabilityExtra
root_attributes.summary: Reachability helpers for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: Local Objective-C helper pod for Reachability convenience APIs.

root_attributes.name: SRWebSocketExtra
root_attributes.summary: SocketRocket helpers for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: Local Objective-C helper pod for SRWebSocket convenience APIs.

root_attributes.name: SYSAlertControllerExtra
root_attributes.summary: UIAlertController category extensions for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
SYSAlertControllerExtra is a local Objective-C category library providing
UIAlertController helper APIs, alert configuration models, and action sheet
presentation helpers for Jobs projects.

root_attributes.name: SZTextViewExtra
root_attributes.summary: SZTextView helpers for Jobs.
root_attributes.description: Local Objective-C helper pod for SZTextView convenience APIs.

root_attributes.name: TFPopupExtra
root_attributes.summary: TFPopup category extensions for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
TFPopupExtra is a local Objective-C category library providing TFPopup helper
methods for popup views, toast presentation, filtration views, and custom views.

root_attributes.name: This
root_attributes.summary: This base object for Jobs Objective-C projects.
root_attributes.description: This provides the base This object used by Jobs Objective-C projects.

root_attributes.name: UIBaseTextFieldDSL
root_attributes.summary: Jobs chain DSL categories for JobsBaseUI text field classes.

root_attributes.name: WHToastExtra
root_attributes.summary: WHToast category extensions for Jobs.
root_attributes.description:
WHToastExtra provides lightweight Objective-C category extensions around WHToast,
including toast display helpers and local image path helpers.

root_attributes.name: YTKNetworkExtra
root_attributes.summary: YTKNetwork extra request helpers for Jobs projects.
root_attributes.description:
YTKNetworkExtra is a local Objective-C extension library that provides base request
classes, request parameter helpers, upload request support, response model mapping,
and loading accessories on top of YTKNetwork.

root_attributes.name: ZFPlayerExtra

root_attributes.description: Local Objective-C helper pod for ZFPlayer convenience APIs and custom control views.
